classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the unknown as opposite the marked angle and the given length as hypotenuse despite changing orientations, select sine, multiply by the hypotenuse and round to two decimal places.

content.prompt: Find the value of each pronumeral, giving your answer correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Horizontal base and vertical right side; right angle at bottom right, 30 degrees at bottom left. Ordinary source blue strokes become house black.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 15 cm; opposite side a cm; reference angle 30 degrees.

answer.worked:
The opposite side and hypotenuse are involved, so use sine.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{a}{15}&=\sin30^\circ\\a&=15\sin30^\circ\\a&=7.50\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal top edge and vertical left edge; right angle at top left and 25 degrees at top right. Ordinary source blue strokes become house black.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 6 cm; opposite side c cm; reference angle 25 degrees.

answer.worked:
The opposite side and hypotenuse are involved, so use sine.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{c}{6}&=\sin25^\circ\\c&=6\sin25^\circ\\c&\approx2.54\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Inverted triangle with horizontal upper hypotenuse and a right angle at its lower vertex; 55 degrees at upper left. Ordinary source blue strokes become house black.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 8.2 cm; side opposite 55 degrees is e cm.

answer.worked:
The opposite side and hypotenuse are involved, so use sine.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{e}{8.2}&=\sin55^\circ\\e&=8.2\sin55^\circ\\e&\approx6.72\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle pointing right with right angle at upper left and 70 degrees at lower left. Ordinary source blue strokes become house black.
spec.mathematics: Lower-left-to-right hypotenuse 15 cm; upper-left-to-right side y cm is opposite 70 degrees.

answer.worked:
The opposite side and hypotenuse are involved, so use sine.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{y}{15}&=\sin70^\circ\\y&=15\sin70^\circ\\y&\approx14.10\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
